communication.title: Asking for and giving directions

dialogues.ask: Excuse me. Could you tell me the way to the cinema, please?
dialogues.answer: Go along this street. It's on your left.

dialogues.ask: Excuse me. Where's the nearest post office, please?
dialogues.answer: Go out of the station. Take the first turning on the right.

communication.audio_task: An audio guide to a place

replacement_guide.text: Let's start our tour in Hoi An. We are in Tran Phu Street now. First, go straight along the street for five minutes. It's on your left. Next, go to the museum. Take the second turning on your left. Turn right and it's on your right. Finally, go to the workshop. It is opposite Tan Ky House.

skills1.title: Khang's blog: My neighbourhood
blog_paragraphs: I live in the suburbs of Da Nang City. There are many things I like about my neighbourhood.

It's great for outdoor activities because it has beautiful parks, sandy beaches and fine weather. There's almost everything I need here: shops, restaurants, and markets. The people here are friendlier, and the food is better than in other places.
However, there are two things I dislike about it: there are many modern buildings and offices; and the streets are busy and crowded.

questions.answer: In the suburbs of Da Nang City.

skills2.title: Listening and writing about a neighbourhood
visible_statements: Vy lives in the centre of Ho Chi Minh City.
There is a big market near her house.
There are some factories near her neighbourhood.

replacement_audio.text: Vy lives near the centre of Ho Chi Minh City. There is a big market near her house. The streets are wide, but they are noisy and crowded. The schools are far away, and there are some factories near her neighbourhood. Vy likes the many shops, restaurants and cafés, the wide streets, and the helpful and friendly people. She dislikes the schools being too far away, the dirty air, and the noisy and crowded streets.

paragraph_frames: There are many things I like about my neighbourhood.
However, there are some things I dislike about it.

project.title: My Map
steps: Draw a map of a neighbourhood. Write names of at least five places on your map.
Work in pairs. Take turns to ask for and give directions to the places on the map.

compare two people or things using comparative adjectives
